subject: POC kickoff & timeline - ACME Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenny Smith <j.smith@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC: ACME Corp - proposed timeline & success criteria

Hi Jenny & Tom,

Thanks for the productive discovery earlier today — good alignment on the key evaluation goals. Per our conversation, I put together a concise POC plan and proposed timeline so we can confirm ownership and next steps. Attaching a quick checklist for execution.

High-level success criteria (from call):
- 95% accuracy on intent classification for the top 12 intents across support transcripts (sample: last 3 months)
- End-to-end latency under 300ms p50 for 1k QPS replay scenarios
- No sensitive data leakage; all logs retained per ACME policy and accessible for audit

Proposed evaluation plan:
- Week 0 (prep): data access, sample upload, security questionnaire
- Week 1–2 (integration): ingest sample data, baseline runs, smoke tests
- Week 3–4 (tuning): model config, caching/batching, quantization trial if needed
- Week 5 (readout): final run, metrics review, decision meeting

Ownership (Redwood):
- Marissa Cole: POC lead / commercial contact
- Dylan Brooks: integration & runtime setup

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the success criteria above or send any edits
2) Confirm preferred kickoff week (we suggested week of Dec 6)
3) Share list of users who need access to the test project

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Jenny Smith <j.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>, ACME POC Team <poc-team@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC: ACME Corp - proposed timeline & success criteria

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: the accuracy target looks right but can we scope to the "customer support" channel only for the POC (we have multiple channels in prod).
- Latency: 300ms p50 is acceptable; can you confirm p95 targets as well? We have strict user-facing thresholds.
- Data: For the prep step, we'll need to know whether Redwood requires direct access to S3 or whether we can provide a pre-signed bundle. Also please include your security contact so we can expedite the questionnaire.

We prefer kickoff the week of Dec 6; best times are Dec 6–8 afternoons PST.

Attaching our evaluation rubric (acme-poc-rubric.xlsx) to help align the readout format.

Jenny Smith
Head of Product Operations | ACME Corp
j.smith@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenny Smith <j.smith@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC: ACME Corp - proposed timeline & success criteria

Hi Jenny — great questions. Confirming the changes and next steps below:

Updated scope / targets:
- Channel: "customer support" only for POC (agreed)
- Latency: target p50 < 300ms, p95 < 450ms (we'll monitor both in the dashboard)

Data transfer options:
- We can accept an S3 location (Redwood will spin up a temporary role) OR you can provide a pre-signed bundle. Dylan will coordinate the exact method and the permissions required.

Security & compliance:
- Looping in Vivek (cc'd) who will share the SOC2 and the short security questionnaire checklist.

Kickoff & timeline (confirmed):
- Kickoff meeting: Dec 7, 2026 at 1:00 PM PST (30–45m) — agenda: goals, access, roles, timeline
- Weekly check-ins: Thursdays 11:00 AM PST starting Dec 10 (30m)
- Final readout: Dec 20, 2026 (1h) — demo + metrics review + next steps

Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa (commercial), Dylan (technical), Vivek (security)
- ACME: Jenny (product ops), Tom (engineering lead)

I've uploaded the POC plan to our shared folder and attached a PDF summary for quick reference.

Attachments: acme_poc_plan_v1.pdf
Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ACME-POC-Redwood

Next steps: Dylan, can you confirm the access steps and calendar invites? Jenny/Tom — I'll send the calendar invites for kickoff once Dylan confirms the S3 vs bundle approach.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC: ACME Corp - proposed timeline & success criteria

Thanks for looping me in. Quick items from security side:

- I've attached our SOC 2 Type II summary for 2025 and a short security checklist that maps to your questionnaire items.
- For the POC we typically accept a pre-signed S3 bundle; if you require direct access we'll provision a temporary role with least privilege and limited TTL.
- Please send the completed security questionnaire; I'll prioritize turnaround on any follow-ups.

Attachment: SOC2-type2-redwood-2025.pdf

I'll also be available on the kickoff call Dec 7 to cover access and data handling.
